what: Stacked plates stuck to the screen (phone mockups and photos) are paired in turn with the text cards beside them, while a card’s bottom edge moves up from the screen center, its paired plate shifts up 5vh, tilts 5° and fades so the next plate is revealed (tied to scroll, no curve). The last plate stays. The table-of-contents line (mark) lights in the accent color while the paired card’s bottom edge is between the screen bottom and top

options.y: Vertical distance to step aside (% of screen height), default -5
options.start: Where the board starts to drop out (ScrollTrigger start), default bottom center
options.from: Only at this width (px) or wider, default 769 — the original lays out the board separately for each card on phones
options.[data-fx-part=layer]: Stacked panels — absolute · sticky positioning to overlap in the same spot is the user’s css. The part assigns z-index so the front panel sits on top
options.[data-fx-part=card]: Paired text cards — at least as many as the panels
